title: Accumulate semantic fact count during canonical block construction

masterplan.active_gate: Gate 1 — Renovation, owner-directed Genesis and general computer assistance

scope: Remove the compiler-side second traversal used only to compute CompiledRelationBlocks.semantic_fact_count after every TypedRelationBlock has already been constructed. Accumulate the exact entry_count during the existing selected-signature construction loop, while retaining CompiledRelationBlocks.__post_init__ as an independent direct-constructor validation boundary. Do not add lazy state, a cache, another receipt family, another compiler, a registry or a second source of truth.

audit.previous_behavior: compile_relation_blocks built the complete bounded compiled list, then traversed that list with sum(block.entry_count for _, block in compiled) to produce semantic_fact_count. CompiledRelationBlocks.__post_init__ independently traversed its validated ordered blocks again to prove the supplied count matches the receipt contents.
audit.finding: The receipt-side scan is required for trustworthy direct construction and must remain independent. The compiler-side post-build scan is not required: block.entry_count is already available at the exact point each canonical block is appended, so the compiler can accumulate the same non-negative integer during that existing required pass without retaining new state beyond one scalar counter.
audit.entry_count_cost: TypedRelationBlock.entry_count is len(self.values), so accumulation does not traverse block entries and does not alter CSR or semiring semantics.

production.change: Initialize semantic_fact_count once beside the existing compiled list, increment it with block.entry_count immediately after each block is appended, and pass that scalar into CompiledRelationBlocks. The separate compiler-side sum over the completed list is removed. CompiledRelationBlocks.__post_init__ is unchanged and still verifies the supplied count independently.

focused_test.change: Extend the existing bounded-receipt test owner with one minimal valid Boolean TypedRelationBlock and prove direct CompiledRelationBlocks construction still rejects semantic_fact_count=0 when the supplied block contains one semantic entry. This pins the independent receipt validation boundary after the compiler-side traversal is removed.

semantic_invariants.receipt_validation: CompiledRelationBlocks.__post_init__ still independently sums validated ordered block entry counts and rejects a mismatching semantic_fact_count for direct construction.
semantic_invariants.count_identity: compile_relation_blocks.semantic_fact_count remains the exact sum of final TypedRelationBlock.entry_count values, including explicit selected empty blocks and deduplicated coordinates.
semantic_invariants.canonical_order: CompiledRelationBlocks still sorts validated blocks by collision-free logical block name; count accumulation does not participate in ordering.
semantic_invariants.semiring_behavior: Boolean, natural and evidence-dag block construction, deduplication and provenance behavior are unchanged.
semantic_invariants.source_of_truth: KnowledgeForest and FourfoldSnapshot remain authoritative; the compiled receipt remains a regenerable computational view.
semantic_invariants.public_api: No public API, wire schema, benchmark schema, compatibility facade, promotion or authority contract changes.

result.summary: The compiler no longer performs a dedicated second pass over its completed block catalog merely to compute semantic_fact_count. It reuses the already-required block-construction pass for the count, while the immutable receipt keeps its independent validation scan so direct construction cannot forge the aggregate.
